title: Words to read and colour: Al-Kawthar
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y1 lesson 44 (Pupil PDF worksheet: words to read and colour)
intro: Lesson 44. Read each word slowly to a grown-up, then colour the part we learned today (Al-Kawthar). Then trace and copy.

arabic.text: إِنَّآ أَعْطَيْنَٰكَ ٱلْكَوْثَرَ (١) فَصَلِّ لِرَبِّكَ وَٱنْحَرْ (٢) إِنَّ شَانِئَكَ هُوَ ٱلْأَبْتَرُ (٣)

panels.title: What it means
points: A translation of the meaning, not the Qur'an itself

questions.q: Say Al-Kawthar together, then each ayah in a different voice: soft, steady, clear.
Listening turns: today's group says Al-Kawthar to the teacher. Everyone else: draw a river and write 'Al-Kawthar' under it on the pupil PDF.
Extend: tell a grown-up what Al-Kawthar means.
questions.a: A river of great good that Allah gave the Prophet ﷺ.

questions.q: Who gave Al-Kawthar to the Prophet ﷺ?
questions.a: A) Allah. 108:1: 'Indeed, We have granted you al-Kawthar.'

questions.q: Think again: Allah promised the Prophet ﷺ Al-Kawthar. Do you think Allah forgets His promises?
questions.a: Never. Allah always keeps His promises, so we trust Him and thank Him.
